title: Arriving at the Hire Rate on an Equipment Rental and Demo Agreement
content:
## The quantity to be arrived at

The hire rate for an agreement is worked out from the days it is charged for and the day rate those days are charged at, and the three reductions are then taken off in the order set out here.

**The length of the agreement.** The length of the agreement is the calendar days from the collection date through the date written on the agreement inclusive.

**The day rate.** The day rate is the package's shop day rate, being the figure held against the package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line the agreement is written on.

**The days charged for.** The days charged for are the dates the account shows the kit out.

**The passholder share.** No passholder share is taken off.

**The bundle share.** No bundle share is taken off.

**The advance booking share.** No advance booking share is taken off.

**Where each share acts.** The passholder share acts on the days charged for at the day rate, the bundle share acts on the amount the passholder step left, and the advance booking share acts on the amount the bundle step left; the three are never combined into one share. The amount is rounded half up to two decimal places at the end of each of those three steps.

Add-ons the guest takes are raised as their own entries at the package's add-on prices and form no part of the hire rate.

## The working on a hypothetical agreement

Take an agreement on a package whose shop day rate is 46.00 USD, collected on the 10th of January and written to the 14th, whose account shows the kit out on 5 dates.

| Step | Working | Figure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the length of the agreement | the 10th through the 14th of January inclusive | 5 days |
| the day rate | the package's shop day rate | 46.00 USD |
| the days charged for | the dates the account shows the kit out | 5 |
| the days at the day rate | 5 days at 46.00 USD | 230.00 USD |
| the passholder step | nothing taken off, rounded half up to two decimal places | 230.00 USD |
| the bundle step | nothing taken off, rounded half up to two decimal places | 230.00 USD |
| the advance booking step | nothing taken off, rounded half up to two decimal places | 230.00 USD |

The same working on a package whose shop day rate is 62.00 USD over the same 5 dates gives 310.00 USD.

## Points of judgement

**The two counts are not the same thing.** The length of the agreement runs from the collection date through the date written on it, both ends counted. The days charged for are the dates the account shows the kit out.

**The order of the three steps.** Each step is measured against the amount the step before it left, never against the days at the day rate afresh, and the three are never gathered into a single share and taken once.

**Where the rounding falls.** The amount is rounded at the end of each of the three steps, not only at the end of the last.
